Class ImporterRegistry

java.lang.Object
global.thalion.ttio.importers.ImporterRegistry
public final class ImporterRegistry extends Object
Encode-format registry: the single source of truth for the formats ttio encode --format <fmt> accepts and how each maps to a .tio. Each spec pairs a format with a Reader instance; encode(String, List, Path, Map) dispatches via reader.read(...).write(output).

fasta / fastq are intentionally NOT registered here: they keep their richer dedicated CLIs and encode delegates to those separately (see CLI_DELEGATED).

Mirrors Python ttio.importers.registry EXACTLY (the cross-language fence; see RegistryParityTest).
